title: Your First Weekend at Harvey Mudd College, Shared as Cards
description: A practical orientation-weekend sequence connecting new-student arrival, recognizable campus spaces, 7C resources, and under-21-safe Claremont outings.

cards.entity_name: Ronald and Maxine Linde Activities Center
cards.title: Start at the LAC Welcome Table
cards.subtitle: Thursday morning arrival at Harvey Mudd
cards.notes: Bring your arrival essentials to the LAC; an Orientation Mentor can guide you from the welcome table to your residence hall.
cards.short_summary: Use Harvey Mudd’s documented orientation starting point to get checked in and connected with a mentor.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd’s 2026 orientation FAQ says the registration and welcome table will operate at the Linde Activities Center from 8–11 a.m. on August 27.
cards.source_title: Orientation FAQs | Student Life | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: The documented 2026 orientation welcome table is open 8–11 a.m. Thursday, August 27; follow event instructions and carry your HMC ID after issuance.

cards.title: Walk the Outdoor Campus Route
cards.subtitle: Thursday afternoon campus bearings
cards.notes: Pick up the virtual self-guided pamphlet from Admission, then trace the outdoor route while noting academic buildings and main paths.
cards.short_summary: Turn the first afternoon into a low-pressure orientation walk across Harvey Mudd’s compact campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd states that self-guided visitors may obtain a virtual tour pamphlet from Admission and that the outdoor route generally takes about an hour.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor self-guided tours require no registration. Do not enter residence halls; follow campus directions and any posted access restrictions.

cards.entity_name: R. Michael Shanahan Center for Teaching and Learning
cards.title: Find the Shanahan Center
cards.subtitle: Thursday afternoon academic landmark
cards.notes: Locate Shanahan while campus is familiarizing itself; note the auditorium and Sprague Patio as reference points for future events.
cards.short_summary: Anchor your mental map with one of Harvey Mudd’s named academic and arts destinations.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd’s Arts visit page locates Drinkward Recital Hall in the R. Michael Shanahan Center for Teaching and Learning and provides a destination map.
cards.source_title: Visit — Arts at Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Use the Arts at Harvey Mudd destination map and observe posted building or event-access requirements before entering interior spaces.

cards.title: Regroup at Platt Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Thursday evening campus home base
cards.notes: Use Platt as a meet-up point after scheduled orientation sessions; keep your student ID with you for controlled evening access.
cards.short_summary: End the arrival day at a central student-life building documented as available to students after hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd’s current annual security report states that student ID cards provide authorized 24-hour access to Platt Campus Center.
cards.source_title: 2025 Harvey Mudd College Annual Fire Safety and Security Report
cards.access_notes: Authorized HMC students use ID-card access after hours. Carry your ID and defer to orientation programming, reservations, and posted room restrictions.

cards.title: Meet Over Weekend Brunch
cards.subtitle: Saturday, 10:30 a.m.–12:45 p.m.
cards.notes: Coordinate a brunch time with your mentor group or hallmates, and confirm your meal-plan or guest-payment method before entering.
cards.short_summary: Use the dining commons’ published weekend service window for an easy first shared meal.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd lists weekend and holiday brunch at Hoch-Shanahan Dining Commons from 10:30 a.m. to 12:45 p.m. and publishes 2026–2027 rates.
cards.source_title: Hoch-Shanahan Dining Commons | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Published weekend brunch is 10:30 a.m.–12:45 p.m.; service and entry may change for holidays or orientation, so check current dining notices.

cards.title: Learn the Library Layout
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon 7C resource stop
cards.notes: Check the live building schedule before leaving, then identify service points and a study area you can return to once coursework begins.
cards.short_summary: Get acquainted with the shared Claremont Colleges library before the academic week starts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Claremont Colleges Library identifies Honnold/Mudd Library at 800 N. Dartmouth Avenue and publishes live daily building hours and closing procedures.
cards.source_title: Building Hours – The Claremont Colleges Library
cards.access_notes: Consult the live hours page on the day of your visit. Exit promptly at closing and follow library identification and guest-access rules.

cards.entity_name: Benton Museum of Art at Pomona College
cards.title: Make an Art Break at the Benton
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon across the 7Cs
cards.notes: Check the visit page for current opening hours, then choose one exhibition to explore rather than trying to cover every gallery.
cards.short_summary: Add a free, public cultural stop to the weekend without leaving the Claremont Colleges area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Benton Museum states that it remains free and open to all and serves the Claremont community with exhibitions, programs, and events.
cards.source_title: Support | Benton Museum of Art at Pomona College
cards.access_notes: Admission is free and the museum is open to all. Verify current public hours and exhibition closures on the museum’s visit page before going.

cards.title: Explore Claremont Village
cards.subtitle: Saturday late-afternoon town orientation
cards.notes: Use the Village’s official shop-and-dine listings to plan a short loop, noting useful cafés, services, and the route back toward campus.
cards.short_summary: Learn the nearby commercial district through a purposeful daylight walk rather than an unplanned shopping trip.
cards.evidence_claim: Harvey Mudd describes its campus as adjacent to historic Claremont Village, while the Village’s official site documents its shops, dining, and services.
cards.source_title: Visit Campus | About | Harvey Mudd College
cards.access_notes: Individual businesses set their own hours, access rules, and prices. Stay on public routes and verify any intended destination directly.

cards.title: Take a Park Reset
cards.subtitle: Sunday morning at 840 N. Indian Hill Boulevard
cards.notes: Bring a ball or simply walk the paths; use the published courts, picnic tables, or open park space without assuming equipment is supplied.
cards.short_summary: Begin Sunday outdoors at a named civic park with several casual recreation options.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Claremont identifies Memorial Park as a 7.2-acre community park with courts, picnic tables, pedestrian amenities, and daily hours of 6 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Memorial Park | City of Claremont, CA
cards.access_notes: Open daily 6 a.m.–10 p.m. Some picnic areas are reservable; obey posted court, event, and facility restrictions.

cards.title: Close with California Flora
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon north of campus
cards.notes: Bring student identification for the posted student rate, arrive before last admission, and walk only on permitted garden paths.
cards.short_summary: Finish the weekend with a structured visit to a documented living collection of California native plants.
cards.evidence_claim: California Botanic Garden lists its address as 1500 N. College Avenue, publishes seasonal Tuesday–Sunday hours, and charges an $11 student admission with ID.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit: Hours & Admission | California Botanic Garden
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday with seasonal closing times; last admission is 30 minutes before closing. Running and jogging on garden paths are prohibited.

warnings: Orientation dates and individual operating hours can change; students should follow their assigned 2026 NSO schedule and check live hours before departure.
Coordinates are included only where a supplied target coordinate or direct government page verified them; all other coordinates and maps URLs are null.
